name: Cashverse staking distributor public depositBNB swaps with no minimum output
summary: An unverified staking reward distributor exposed depositBNB() without access control. Once any stake existed it swapped its entire BNB balance for ADAcash on PancakeSwap with amountOutMin 0. The attacker pumped ADAcash with flash-borrowed WBNB, called depositBNB() so the distributor bought at the inflated price, and sold its ADAcash back into the pair.
notes: depositBNB() is a no-op while total stake (slot 7) is zero; the owner's first enterStaking in November 2024 made it nonzero. Total stake is a live value any staker could set (the staking token was fixed in the constructor), so it is not a reset; the runtime and its swap path date from deployment.

The distributor has no verified source; selector names come from the public signature database. Missing access control is shown by the attacker contract, created in the same block, being served, and by a debug_traceCall from an arbitrary address reaching the router swap.
